sources.title: Fastino Labs
sources.snippet: Fastino Labs builds open language and decision models for agentic AI, including GLiNER, GLiDE and the Fastino fine-tuning agent. See our research and models.

sources.title: GLiDE: a decision model for typed questions - docs.fastino.ai
sources.snippet: GLiDE (Generalized Lightweight Decision Engine) is a decision model. It evaluates the application state you provide against one or more typed questions and returns structured answers, probabilities, and confidence across outcomes you define. GLiDE costs $0.15 per 1 million input tokens. Output tokens are free ($0). See Pricing for the current inference rates.

sources.title: fastino/GLiDE · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GLiDE is a decision model from Fastino. Given a state (text or JSON, optionally with images) and one or more typed questions, it returns a probability for every option of every question.
